title: chore(db): remove SQLite support, use MariaDB exclusively
body:
## Summary
- Deletes `switch-database.ts` script and its ADR — the source of issues caused by accidentally switching the Prisma schema to SQLite
- Regenerates the init migration with proper MySQL/MariaDB syntax (was generated with SQLite: wrong types, quoting, missing charset/collation, missing enum)
- Narrows `DATABASE_PROVIDERS` in config to `['mysql']` only and fixes the default value
- Removes `sqlite3` devDependency and `.db` watch-ignore flags from `start:dev`

## Test plan
- [ ] Run `prisma migrate reset --force` and verify migration applies cleanly against MariaDB
- [ ] Start the app and verify it boots without config validation errors
